title: Bias after Prompting: Persistent Discrimination in Large Language Models
findings: The study found a moderate correlation (ρ ≥ 0.69) for the demographic category of religion between the intrinsic biases of pre-trained models and the extrinsic biases present after prompt adaptations. This indicates that biases related to religion transfer from the base model to the prompted model. Furthermore, some prompt-based debiasing strategies were inconsistent in their effect, with the level of bias transfer being retained for the religion category.
